bootstrap.title: Bootstrap / Initial load
bootstrap.intro: Create several accounts at once from a CSV file. Each row is processed on its own: a failed row never stops the import.
bootstrap.formatHelp: The first line must be exactly: {{headers}}. One account per line after that.
bootstrap.columnFullname: fullname: the display name of the account (free text).
bootstrap.columnEmail: emailaddress: the full address, domain included (for example user@example.com).
bootstrap.columnPassword: password: at least 8 characters with an upper case letter, a lower case letter, a digit and a symbol.
bootstrap.columnQuota: quota: a number is megabytes (512); 512MB, 1G and 1T are also accepted. Empty means unlimited.
bootstrap.ruleDomain: The domain must already exist on this server and you must be allowed to manage it.
bootstrap.rulePassword: Passwords that do not meet the policy above are rejected.
bootstrap.ruleQuota: An invalid quota is rejected; empty or 0 means unlimited.
bootstrap.ruleExisting: An account that already exists is never modified: its row is skipped and reported.
bootstrap.rulePartial: A failing row is skipped and the import continues with the next one.
bootstrap.invalidHeaders: The header must start with: fullname,emailaddress,password,quota (optional trailing columns: passwordhash, problem)
bootstrap.readError: The file could not be read.
bootstrap.failedHelp: The failed rows can be downloaded as a CSV with the reason of each one; fix them and upload the file again.
bootstrap.empty: The file has no account rows.
bootstrap.columnPasswordhash: passwordhash: a pre-hashed password (argon2id or md5crypt) to store verbatim — for migrating users from another system without knowing their plaintext passwords. Quoted if it contains commas.
bootstrap.rulePasswordhash: md5crypt hashes are rejected after 2027-02-01 (weak-scheme removal). Invalid hash formats fail the row.
